about.label: About Me
about.p1: Backend-focused R&D engineer at MST who turns manual operations into production systems — a browser-automation platform, a fraud-detection system with an ML ban predictor, and a 7-agent LLM orchestration layer. I own problems end-to-end: schema design and APIs, background jobs, security hardening, CI/CD, and tests.
about.p2: Started in game development, moved through managing 100+ Google Ads accounts across 20+ countries, then built the automation tools myself — reducing an 8-person operations team to 1, backed by a 93-test suite. Treat AI as a force multiplier and pick the language for the task, not the habit.
about.p3: Day to day I work in TypeScript/Node.js with PostgreSQL, Redis, and BullMQ, and use Python for data-heavy work. Strong algorithmic foundation from competitive programming.
